source: r11/features.json (93 items) split and prioritised on 23 October; re-scored 5 November, after the second overnight run against getcurate/reel-studio main d4185a3 and its open PRs, and fork/redesign-beta at 3f0ee19

legend.scores: 50 → 20 means old UI % → Redesign Beta %. Old UI is Aiden's repo or an open PR. New is fork/redesign-beta, UX and function together.
old: prototype or fork branch, no PR
open PR with a Blocking item, no review yet, or CI missing or cancelled
open PR, no Blocking item, CI passing; waiting on Aiden
new: a stub, or code nothing exercises
partly built, or an older version of the PR
works, with spec gaps or PR fixes not brought over
built and tested in the redesign; polish only
unused: nobody has launched the packaged redesign build
sizes: crosses engine, AI and app, or adds a subsystem
changes the project schema or the architecture, or is a new product
legend.notes: An epic's scores average its children (dropped items left out), and it shows its most urgent child's priority. n/a means the old UI has nothing to compare (a redesign-only task). Size is blast size: how much code a change touches.
